changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE extra record; BEGIN FOR extra IN WITH candidate AS ( SELECT c.oid, n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS index_name, c.relam, i.indnkeyatts, i.indkey::text AS keys, i.indclass::text AS opclasses, i.indcollation::text AS collations, i.indoption::text AS options, pg_get_expr(i.indexprs, i.indrelid) AS expressions, pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid) AS predicate, c.reloptions::text AS storage, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conindid = c.oid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND d.refobjid = c.oid) AS needed, coalesce(s.idx_scan, 0) AS scans FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_all_indexes s ON s.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.indrelid = to_regclass('analytics.events') AND i.indisvalid AND i.indisready AND i.indislive AND NOT i.indisunique), ranked AS ( SELECT candidate.*, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY relam, indnkeyatts, keys, opclasses, collations, options, expressions, predicate, storage ORDER BY needed DESC, scans DESC, oid DESC) AS copy FROM candidate) SELECT schema_name, index_name FROM ranked WHERE copy > 1 AND NOT needed LOOP RAISE NOTICE 'Dropping duplicate index %.%', extra.schema_name, extra.index_name; EXECUTE format('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS %I.%I', extra.schema_name, extra.index_name); END LOOP; END $$
